# VibeCoded Orchestrator

> A local knowledge graph and code graph for Claude Code, plus automation hooks, MCP servers and a launcher GUI, so Claude stops forgetting your project between sessions. Open source (AGPL-3.0-or-later), runs entirely on your machine. Status: alpha.

## Start here

- [QuickStart](https://vibecodedtools.com/quickstart): install in about 10 minutes of active time (Linux, macOS, Windows)
- [README](https://github.com/hotak92/vibecoded-orchestrator/blob/main/README.md): what it does, install, compatibility, licensing, telemetry
- [Getting started](https://github.com/hotak92/vibecoded-orchestrator/blob/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md): install and first-session walkthrough
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/hotak92/vibecoded-orchestrator/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)
